note: Status per packet DRY family: concretized (this concept renders a native composition of the role), reused (consumed via shared data/semantics without new composition), not-exercised (belongs to another concept's surfaces). Variance notes are the anti-clone evidence: same product behavior, deliberately different composition — in this concept, everything is a sheet in a stack.

entries.variance_notes: Destinations are full-width typographic plates with a mono number gutter and a health footnote; managers get icon plates in the same column. No cards, no tiles, no pills.
Home compresses every notice into ONE queue row; the full grouped queue is a pushed sheet. The calm state is a genuinely calm dashed row, not an empty list.
One live surface at a time on a layer stack with a vertical-rl spine and depth counter; there is no sidebar at all — the signature of this concept.
Home search replaces the plates in place; sheet headers carry a compact popover variant. Manager-receipt results name the covering concept and open the receipt sheet.
Category switching is spatial: pop the spine or sideways-swap via the outline overlay; never a persistent nav column.
The spy drives a single sticky chip whose text crossfades (fixed geometry, opacity swap only) and refines the route with replaceState.
Registry rows render from PMState.resolveRowState; manager-owned values use the same row silhouette via controlRow so both kinds read identically at a glance.
Shared chip silhouettes sit in a dedicated chip line under the label — the lowest-density placement of the four concepts.
Reasons are sentences in the row note or the funnel trace ('No display on the Home TrueNAS runner'), never bare badges.

entries.concept_component: fs-facts pairs with is-attention effective rows
entries.variance_notes: One dl-pair pattern serves LSP attachment, MCP protocol negotiation, role routing, and model routing — all resolved through PMProvider.resolveRoute so the difference can never be papered over.
Every native manager is a SHEET STACK — list sheet, detail sheet, diagnostics sheet — not a manual (c1), console (c2), or ledger (c4). Deep links reconstruct multi-sheet stacks.

entries.concept_component: mrowBtn rows + fs-acct cards + detail sheets
entries.variance_notes: Lists are quiet grid rows; detail is a pushed sheet, never in-place expansion — disclosure is navigation, the concept's law.

entries.concept_component: managerFootnote on plates + summary lines in sheets
entries.variance_notes: Health compresses to one footnote sentence per plate ('2 of 4 formatters ready · 1 not found') and one intro line per manager sheet.
Numbered steppers on half sheets; the cursor-cli offer adds the host radio, the disabled-until-chosen install button, and the install-is-not-sign-in caution.

entries.concept_component: fs-opline driven by store op events
entries.variance_notes: Phases render as italic sentences on the owning card/sheet (verifying lists the seven conditions); state changes are never skipped under reduced motion.

entries.concept_component: PMShell.toast over receipt events + fs-covered receipt sheets
entries.variance_notes: Cross-concept receipts are their own sheet kind with a real anchor that carries the manager route to the sibling page.

entries.concept_component: vault-reference copy in provider/MCP auth facts
entries.variance_notes: Secrets appear only as vault references in fact rows; no reveal or copy affordance exists anywhere in the concept.
Providers are list rows with the two-step status (signed in vs runs models) rendered as two explicit steps with an arrow — the family card is the detail sheet.
Cards with an auto-fit fact grid; priority is a numbered fact, use-next is a chip, and every action is a labeled button.

One humanized card per installation on its own sheet; actions come only from the resolver (manual-only cards get none); the two-entry rollback history renders as log lines; forensics live one sheet deeper.
Fav star, meta chips, and a stay-open effort+speed menu; the Haiku fastNote renders in both the row extra and the evidence sheet.

entries.concept_component: fs-evidence list on the evidence half sheet
entries.variance_notes: Capability, state word, source, and timestamp per line; claims are never shown without a source.
